# Release Notes: Version 6.7.1-beta9 


**Release Date:** Nov, 2025

---

## 🚀 New Features
 - Feature 1: Added menu item to S? counters to clear all AC flags (same behavior as CTL-ALT-X).

---

## 🛠 Bug Fixes
 - Fix 1: Depletable ammo tag for Finnish 75L PstK/40 (g) and Sturmi (g) counters.
 - Fix 2: Fixed various issues with Chinese guns' info text.

---

## 📈 Improvements
 - Improvement 1: Added partial red text support to info text to match physical counters of various U.S. Halftracks.
 
---

## ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
- **Minimum Version Required:** Built with VASSAL 3.7.18

---
